global.title: Sanofi inks massive $41B Insmed buyout for post-Dupixent growth drivers
global.summary: Sanofi has struck a deal to acquire Insmed for $41 billion, securing three commercial and late-phase respiratory assets to offset Dupixent’s looming loss of exclusivity.

global.title: Cogent Biosciences gains FDA approval for Ekitna combo in GIST
global.summary: The US FDA has approved Cogent Biosciences’ Ekitna in combination with sunitinib for adult patients with advanced GIST who previously received imatinib.

china.title: Bayer signs $3.25bn oncology deal with Hansoh Pharma
china.summary: Bayer has entered into an exclusive worldwide licensing agreement potentially valued at up to $3.25bn with Hansoh Pharma to develop, manufacture, and commercialise the Phase I oncology candidate HS-20122.
